name: repo_query
description: Read-only git repo state queries for the rsi-agent workspace (no writes, no network): status (branch + porcelain dirty list), diff_stat (working tree+staged vs HEAD, i.e. what would be committed), log (last 10 oneline), remote (remotes with urls), branch (current + upstream). Use before committing to verify exactly what will be committed.

query.description: status | diff_stat | log | remote | branch; default 'status'
